title: An Afternoon on the Rhine
introTitle: A slower afternoon along the Rhine.
intro: After a relaxed morning in Frankfurt, the day leaves plenty of room for an easy afternoon drive toward the Rhine Valley. The plan is intentionally simple: enjoy some river scenery, spend a little time around the Rüdesheim area, and return to Frankfurt without turning the day into another long road trip.

stops.name: Frankfurt
stops.description: Enjoy a slower morning in Frankfurt before heading west toward the Rhine.

stops.name: Rhine Valley — Rüdesheim Area
stops.description: Spend part of the afternoon along the Rhine near Rüdesheim, with time for river views and a relaxed stop before heading back.
